headers.name: YPY-Commands
headers.description: A JSON list of typed client commands that run after the response was swapped, with no eval. Each command has a `type` and a `target` (a CSS selector; the command acts on every match): `addClass`, `removeClass`, `toggleClass` (`class`, optional `force`), `setAttribute` (`name`, `value`), `removeAttribute` (`name`), `focus`, `scrollIntoView` (`behavior`, `block`, `inline`), `remove`, `dispatch` (`event`, `detail`, `bubbles`; the target is optional and defaults to the document), `show` and `hide`. An unknown or invalid command is ignored with a console warning.

events.name: ypy:before:command
events.description: Fires on the element that sent the request before one command of `YPY-Commands` runs. `targets` are the elements the selector matched. Cancel it to skip that command.

events.name: ypy:commands:ignored
events.description: Fires on the element that sent the request when a command, or the whole list, of `YPY-Commands` was not run: unknown type, an invalid field, an invalid selector, a blocked attribute (an event handler, `style`, `srcdoc`, an attribute of YPY or a `javascript:` URL), a list that is not JSON or is longer than `commands.max`. A console warning says the same.

config.name: commands.max
config.description: Most commands a `YPY-Commands` list may hold; a longer list is ignored as a whole.
